decisions.map: At least 60% of the initial viewport belongs to geographic evidence. No filler is used to balance its empty geographic areas.
decisions.masthead: The identity and clock fit inside compact chrome; an install action belongs in Tools, not a third title line.
decisions.theater: A visible selector reserves at least 110px; on a phone the full selector moves to Tools.
decisions.drawers: Intelligence and status instruments open on request. Their scroll area holds earned content, not an empty fixed-height card.
decisions.reference: Border assessments have no observation date. The panel says undated and unverified; blank observation dates are not replaced with response time.

verification: scripts/live-suite-check.mjs measures actual CSS breakpoints and neighbours, captures preset views and falsifies the rendered overlap or map-size guard. This baseline records reasons; it is not an exemption from the checks.
